name: canti_badge
about: The floating badge's pixel Canti: the icon's head on a jointed robot body. Made by brand/tools/canti_sprite.py; don't edit by hand.
scale: Draw each art px as n x n device px, n = max(1, round(density x artPxDp)) (4 px at density 2.625), nearest neighbour, at whole-pixel positions.

idle.about: Armed, waiting for a hum: calm crescent eyes, a slow blink, the head bobbing a pixel on its collar with the antenna swaying a beat behind. Lamp dull (it lights orange only while hearing); body lights unlit.

hearing.about: A hum in progress: eyes up, a level meter, the lamp's halo pulsing, shoulder and hip lights lit, the antenna quivering with its tip bead pulsing.

hearing_once.about: A sound that caused no action (one-shot): one beat of the meter.

pending.about: Waiting for the second sound: round expectant eyes, dots counting, lamp and body lights yellow, the antenna tilting up to listen.

scroll_up.about: One-shot after a scroll up: an arrow runs up the screen, the forearms push up, the head lifts, the antenna whips back and settles.

scroll_down.about: One-shot after a scroll down: an arrow runs down the screen, the head dips, the antenna flicks up and settles.

hold_scroll_up.about: Scrolling up while the hum is held: chevrons stream up, the head leans into it, the antenna streams with a steady wobble. BadgeState.HOLD_SCROLL plays the last scroll's direction.

hold_scroll_down.about: Scrolling down while the hum is held: chevrons stream down, the head leans into it, the antenna streams with a steady wobble. BadgeState.HOLD_SCROLL plays the last scroll's direction.

back.about: One-shot after Back: the left arm points left, an arrow runs left on the screen, the antenna trails the swing.

forward.about: One-shot after Forward: the right arm points right, an arrow runs right, the antenna trails.

home.about: One-shot after Home: a crouch, a hop with both mitts up, a house on the screen; the antenna bounces on the hop.

cursor.about: Cursor mode: reticle eyes that lock in and out; the antenna stiff and straight, pointing.

paused.about: Paused: eyes shut, a pixel z drifting up the screen, lamp dull, a slow breath; the antenna drooping.

off.about: Off / disconnected: the off icon's face (dark eyes, lamp unlit), head sunk on the collar, antenna limp, still.

error.about: Stop / error (held): the lamp and body lights flash red twice, then stay red; eyes squint, the antenna jitters.

error_once.about: A failed action (one-shot): the lamp and body lights flash red twice, eyes squint, the antenna jitters.

ignored_once.about: A sound heard but not acted on (one-shot, rate-limited by the service): flat eyes, a wavy mouth, a quick shrug with a glance aside; lamp dull, no meter.

tap_to_wake.about: Asleep after a link drop, a tap wakes it (the app arms the Pico): drowsy half-lidded eyes, then TAP glowing on the face screen, alternating slowly; lamp dull, antenna half-drooped.

joy_idle.about: Voice joystick (cursor mode, Face A): the pitch bar's step and the vowel pointer; a still frame the service picks per tick.
